book.name: Zân
book.title: Zân Zisasiyet yaŋaŋ Zânaŋ meluwaŋ mge.

content: Lasalus gakime bewien
Betani mka msalen ke an ŋen mamtan kwitnaŋ Lasalus ek zawat temaŋ penaŋ mti tapme ipmanet Maliamak Mata egelaŋ ke tati mamomtatemun.
Lasalusiyet ipmaŋ Malia kapiyaŋ maneti bam Amobotnaŋ Zisas gakikiŋaŋgalen kan bududuk beme wet kelakŋaŋ sesikŋaŋ dolakŋaŋ penaŋ piyaŋ ek setnanen zulutpemti ŋoksinaŋaŋ kaput pewe.
Lasalusiyet ipmanet zut keyaŋ iwitdaŋgat yayaŋ mti Zisasmagen zet pigok bemalu mege: “Amobotnaŋ, nodi penaŋ Lasalus piwan zawat temaŋ tapm weingat kot eksenik.”

Âpme Zisasiyaŋ zet ke nâmti pigok zeye, “Zawat keyet penaŋaŋ wa gakiki sokbembeyet yek. Kawawaŋgat Nemuŋaŋ egalen kwizet buŋamaŋ msalen pien palakŋaŋ beme Kawawaŋgat kwizet buŋamaŋ mwat onzempepeyet kegok sokbein.”
Zisasiyaŋ Lasalus ipmanet Matamak Malia ekŋen kemak notn notn dolakŋaŋ mti mamtemien.
Âpme Zisasiyaŋ zapat ke nâmpemti mka keyegak kasup zut pi ewe tage.
Yaŋ msame wati Zisasiyaŋ nembaŋane ningat pigok zeye, “Kame naman Zudia mkaenak gilik zemti metne.”
Zeme nin pigok dunduwenn, “An zikat indanda, geŋ alagati kanda manepemane nanzaŋaŋ gosâgât mme kunzuŋti kotn yanaman keyegak gilik zemti mesâgât tazenik?”
Yaŋkwesimann pigok dinndoye, “Pi ewe tambuŋanak mulup mimiyelen kan ewe teepmaŋ tazin. An ŋen kasupgat zikatnaŋ ekmâtâti mepme kwileki ŋenaŋ sekŋaŋ ŋen ku mawalezin.
An ŋenaŋ tambuyet mamezin beme egaŋ busatnaŋ ku tazingapmti tambusosokgat pumpem pumpem olat metiŋgut tep palen ma nanzaŋ palen mee sekŋaŋ mawalezin.”
Kegok zemti zet ŋen ewe pigok tusumti ningat zeye, “Notn Lasalus ek zawat mti muluk tawein yaŋ neŋ meti butema wasem.”
Zeme nembaŋane nin pigok zewenn, “Amobotnaŋ, egaŋ zawat mti muluk tawen beme ikŋaŋ ŋep alik bemti wabe.”
Zisasiyaŋ Lasalus penaŋ gakiye ke met mme wawagat nâmti zeye. Âpme nemba nin nâmann zawat mti muluk tawenaŋ met buteme wasem kok nâmti zewenn.
Âpme Zisasiyaŋ naman pigok weyaŋ zemkawaŋ bemndaye, “Lasalus ek tambumbu tuk weŋge yaŋ neŋ meti butema ewe wasem.
Neŋ zawat zapatnaŋ nâmban yaŋgut kapiyegak mamann gakiyan. Âpme neŋ ekmagen mulup mma in ekti nâmkiŋpepe kaliŋaŋ aikbep keyepmti nâma dolakŋaŋ penaŋ bein. Ele kame nin ilak ek eksât metne.”

Âpme ninmagengatnaŋ nemba ŋen kwitnaŋ Tomas kwitnaŋ ŋen Glik zeleset Didimas makumtemien ke ningalen zeleset nemba pepet kok zewanek. Egaŋ nin pigok dinndoye, “Kame nin sambe bepi nsakwep ekmak mepmann ndome gakimâbanup.”
Zisas ek gakikiengatnan wawat ma mama keyet toŋaŋ
Zisasmak nin ewe kainde maman Lasalus met beme kasup zulak zulak pi sumen weme egaŋ bam mege. Keyepmti kwapataŋ zemann am ekŋenaŋ zewien, “Lasalus ilak tugan bewen.”
Betani mka ke beŋan penaŋ yek; Zelusalem mka temaŋ keyet sokŋanik. (Mail zut mee kegok mamekotemien.)
Keyepmti Zuda am sambe ekŋenaŋ Matamak Malia iwit gakime ambembesi mimidesât mepmâbien.
Âpme Matayaŋ Zisasmak nin kotnup zeme nâmti weneŋaŋ ke tapme egaŋ windembem toti selen meti ndaige.
Kegok mti Zisasiyet pigok dunduye, “Amobotnaŋ, geŋ kapi mambek ze ipm ku gakinak.
Yaŋgut alak pigogat geŋ kwileki ŋeniyet nâmti bipdi dundum samane egaŋ keyet penaŋaŋ ŋep mamgain.”
Zeme Zisasiyaŋ pigok dunduye, “Geŋ yayaŋ ku mi, ipdi Lasalus ek ŋep gilik zemti wasem.”
Zeme nâmti Matayaŋ pigok zeye, “Maneti bam kan temanen gilik zemti wabe e ŋep nâyap.”
Zeme Zisasiyaŋ pigok zeye, “Gakikiengatnan wawat ma mama keyet ŋotekŋaŋ neŋ keyepmti am ŋenaŋ neŋ nâmkiŋpemnewe beme gakiwe yaŋgut neŋ ŋep mamaŋaŋ ewe gilik zemsawap.
Ma am ŋen ewe sekŋaŋ melesiŋ mamti neŋ nâmkiŋpemnewe beme egaŋ gakikipiŋ mamambe. Geŋ neŋ zet zeyap kapi ŋep nâmkiŋpenik?”
Zeme Matayaŋ zeye, “Amobotnaŋ, geŋ Kilais, Kawawaŋgat Nemuŋaŋ, msalen kapi totogat buŋam zapatnaŋ zenzeŋaŋ elak geŋ kapi e penaŋ nâmkiŋpemgeyap.”
Zet kegok zemti met weneŋaŋ Maliayet zeme kopme igak buzak pigok dunduye, “An zikat indanda ilak kotati gâgât tazein.”
Zeme Maliayaŋ nânâŋak wati sakwep Zisasmak nin tabenen mege.
Nin mka set biman baen tati Mata zempeme kwapme ewe keyegak totapmambenn.
Zeme nâmti Maliayaŋ mka keŋangatnan sakwep wawatnak toti mepme Zuda am ekmak ambembesien tapmambien ekŋenaŋ wa sumen daen susât mezin mene zemti mâti kwatopmâbien.
Âpme Maliayaŋ windembemti mka set biman baen toti ndikme tapmmann Zisas pedondom samti pigok zeye, “Amobotnaŋ, geŋ kapi tabek ze ipm ŋep ku gakinak.”
Zemti sume Zuda am ek mâti mebien ekŋenaŋ ek mukulem mti ambembesi temaŋ mbien. Tapmme Zisasiyaŋ indikti keŋaŋ bekanaŋ penaŋ beme siyaŋ bimaŋ soye.
Some pigok indayaŋkwesiye, “In sekŋaŋ pe denen bemien?” Indayaŋkwesime ekŋenaŋ zewien, “Amobotnaŋ, kopmane meti sumaŋ zikat gaman ekbak.”
Met zikat same ekti Zisasiyaŋ siap ulu alep timti suye.
Sume Zuda am ekŋenaŋ ekti zewien, “An pi an kapimak notn notn penaŋ mti mamalup keyepmti egat tasuin egip.”
Âpme notnaŋ ekŋenaŋ zewien, “An kapi an ŋen zikatnaŋ beŋaŋ ŋen weyaŋpeye keyet zapatnaŋ mekopme nâmbenn. Kogogapm an kapi sakwep kodak ze Lasalus kapi ŋep weyaŋpeme alik tadak.”
Âpme Zisasiyaŋ keŋaŋ ewe bekanaŋ penaŋ beme sum sokŋan penaŋ mebenn. Lasalus gakime sekŋaŋ mti met miŋa keŋan wepemti nanzaŋ temaŋ ŋen wilili peme met einzuŋaŋ bekek tage.

Keyet mti Zisasiyaŋ sumpemti pigok zeye, “In nanzaŋ temaŋ kapi kwanzepeme kaiŋan melak.” Zeme an gakiye keyet mâŋaŋaŋ pigok zeye, “Amobotnaŋ, tambumbu zulak zulak ilak sumen tapme tozin yalak pi sek sesikŋaŋ tapein pi zigogat nanzaŋ kwanzempepeyet tazenik.”
Zeme Zisasiyaŋ pigok dunduye, “Neŋ zet daen diŋgoya e nâmane betetnaŋ bein. Geŋ belak nâmkiŋpem nemane neŋ Kawawaŋgalen winde keyet penaŋaŋ mma sokbeme eksenik.”

Âpme am notnaŋ ekŋenaŋ nanzaŋ temaŋ bepiwan kwanzepeme mepme Zisasiyaŋ zikatnaŋ kululuŋen gwaen ekme mopme pigok dunduye, “Bien, geŋ dundundun kan kataŋ nâmti manamukulem mnik keyepmti wisikŋ diŋgoyap. Neŋ am maŋge sambe talip ekŋen kapiyaŋ neŋ giti penaŋ zemnemane koban keyet yaŋaŋ ekmâtâtâtgat mulup msât tati diŋgoyap.”
Kegok zemti kwizet temaŋ pigok kuye, “Lasalus, geŋ pien kwatot!”

Zeme am gakikiŋaŋ piwan banisiyaŋ setnaŋ betnaŋ kwasim pepeŋaŋ ma ŋokŋaŋ saŋgum meselem zempewien melesiŋ kwatopme Zisasiyaŋ zeye, “In banisiyaŋ betetak temaŋ mpepeŋaŋ e kwalet pemti peme melak.” Zeme kwalet pewien.
Zuda an ŋeŋaŋ ekŋenaŋ Zisas kume gakikiyet zemdelaŋ zempewien
Âpme Zuda am sambe Maliayet ipmaŋgat siyet kobien ekŋenmagengatnaŋ am sambe notnaŋaŋ Zisasiyaŋ muluwaŋ mamanamaŋ mme ekti nâmkiŋpempewien.
Âpme notnaŋaŋ belak Palisi ekŋenmagen meti Zisasiyaŋ Lasalus gakikiengatnan mme watage keyet zet zapatnaŋ mimindawien.

Minindame nâmti sâpe sâpe bumbu an ŋeŋaŋ temaŋ ma Palisi egat kandaŋan mambien ekŋenaŋ an ŋeŋaŋ bembe notnaŋ indazemtetime kot ondekme pigok diindowien, “An kapi muluwaŋ mamanamaŋ omba penaŋ am sutnan tapmmezin kapi zigok msawanup?

Nin nâmti belak nâmpemti mamann am sambe bepi ekmagen met tusumâpme delaŋ zeme Loma amobotnaŋ manndadamuŋ min egaŋ ekme ŋep ku beme ningalen sesewat mka temaŋ pi kumasek yaloŋti aminne eyo indom yalom bep!”
Ekŋengat tuŋguwinaŋgatnaŋ an ŋen kwitnaŋ Kaipas ek kan keyet sâpe sâpe bumbu sambe ekŋengat ŋeŋaŋin mamtan. An keyaŋ pigok diindoye, “In sambe bekapi keŋinpiŋ penaŋ!
Nin am sambe bekapi waleletgat zapat etaŋ bemâpmann ŋep ku bewe keyepmti an kwewaŋ ningat dopm gakimti am sambe pi ma nin mee eyo ndamukulem mbe.”

Zet ke belak ikŋaŋgat keŋaŋgalak ku zeye. Kawawaŋaŋ zet ke keŋanen beme zemkawaŋ beye. Nup kan keyet egaŋ sâpe sâpe bumbu sambe ekŋengat ŋeŋaŋin mamtan keyepmti kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ bam sokbewe keyet zetnaŋ zemkawaŋ beye. Zisas ek penaŋ Zuda am nin yomengatnan gilik zemti ndatitiyet gakikiyet zenzeŋaŋ.
Wa ke Zuda am ekŋen etaŋ indamukulem mimiyet etaŋ ku gakiwe. Egaŋ gakimti am Kawawaŋgalen maŋge msat kataŋ mamanup nin bepi ondekndeme maŋga kwep bemti mamambanup.
Âpme Zuda an ŋeŋaŋ ekŋenaŋ kan keyet yaŋbemti Zisas kume gakikiyet zetnaŋ mbien.

Âpme Zisas Zuda amobotnaŋ ekŋenaŋ mineti gakikiŋaŋ temaŋ ewe tapme sutnateman kume gakinakmagengapmti Zuda msalen sosok penaŋ ku maŋge egaŋ nin msat tuŋgupman keyet ganzenan mka ŋen kwitnaŋ Epalaim zeme ke met mamtemenn.
Zuda am ekŋengalen Aŋgalalaŋ Kendoŋin ke sokŋan beme mka isisikŋaŋ am sambe ekŋenaŋ Zelusalem mka teman yominaŋgat nâmti Kawawaŋgat sâpe sâpe busâgât eweŋanak ŋeŋaŋ mepmâbien.
Meti Zuda am ekŋenaŋ sesewat mka temanen motati Zisas zimosetnaŋ timati ilinak met zenâm kot zenâm mti zewien, “An kapi pe Aŋgalalaŋ Kendoyet kapi kopme eksenup manze weyaŋ zeme nâne.”
Zeme Palisi an ma sâpe sâpe bumbu ŋeŋaŋ ekŋenaŋ zet pigok am zemkabem indawien, “Zisas kopme ekti ningat kot sakwep zemsokbemndaseip. Mme nin an ke wati met mka katikŋaŋ pesenup.”
